lessons.text: Never use ad hominem (Attacking the arguer instead of the argument). It cost you against Vincent van Gogh.

Your winning pattern: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.
